verdict.rationale: Base44 documents its own in-app AI agents that update records, trigger workflows and connect to tools, which covers the agent half of the story. Nothing in the evidence says these agents run without provider keys, and the only documented route to LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Mistral) is through 'any other AI platform that uses an API key', which suggests the user does manage keys for direct LLM calls. Missing for 10: documented key-free built-in LLM calls, explicit statement that agents need no provider keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself

citations.quote: AI agents turn simple chats into actions in your Base44 app. Instead of only replying with text, they update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools
Define agent behavior, permissions, and tools using local JSONC configuration files.
